description: This line plot illustrates the results of an ablation study on different model variants, showing how the performance metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—change as components are removed. The x-axis represents the model variants, labeled from left to right as “Model (Ours)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”, and is plotted on a linear scale without numerical tick marks. The y-axis represents the “Metric (%)”, ranging from 58% to 66%, with tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. The purple line with circular markers represents Precision, starting at 65.49% for “Model (Ours)” and ending at 64.06% for “w/o Attention”. The blue line with circular markers represents Recall, starting at 65.49% for “Model (Ours)”, dropping to 59.64% for “w/o Prompt”, rising to 62.63% for “w/o Augmentation”, then declining to 59.17% for “w/o Attention”, and finally to 56.82% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The brown line with circular markers represents F1-score, starting at 65.78% for “Model (Ours)”, decreasing to 60.16% for “w/o Prompt”, increasing to 62.22% for “w/o Augmentation”, then decreasing to 59.67% for “w/o Attention”, and finally to 57.74% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
